brief: A patio bed for tomatoes and the plants that help them grow. A back row of three planters, each three storeys deep, with micro tomatoes in two of them and a pepper in the middle one; a low front row of three one-storey planters with basil, marigold and nasturtium. Fill every planter with soil and plant it.

lines.label: Bin, full depth, drained, 3 stories deep

events.text: Building your tomato patio bed — tall back row and low front row, soil-filled and planted.
